sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-MLX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B — a 2B open model that leads the… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: MiniCPM5-2B is OpenBMB's new 2.52B-parameter open model for phones and laptops. It averages 53.9 across the maker's benchmark set, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, and ships under Apache-2.0 with a 131K-token context.
